Name: VibeDefend by CybeDefend
Tagline: The one command line to secure your Cursor and Claude Code
Description: VibeDefend installs on your AI coding agent (Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Copilot, Codex and more) with one command. From then on the agent writes with your business rules, mined from your repo, and your security rules in its context. It scans each diff while the file is still open, and a guard refuses rm -rf, sudo or a read of your secrets before it runs. Scanners check code after the commit, this runs before the line is written. Free plan, no card.

Name: MCP Connectors by Databox
Tagline: Give your AI Analyst context to explain performance and act
Description: Connect your AI Analyst to the tools your business runs on. It pulls context from your CRM or support desk, so every answer reflects what's happening in your business, and it can act on what it finds. Choose from 10+ connectors or add any MCP server.

Name: Vitals 
Tagline: A Mac activity monitor that thinks in apps, not processes
Topics: Mac, Developer Tools, Menu Bar Apps
Description: Activity Monitor lists a thousand processes, a hundred of them called Google Chrome Helper. Vitals adds every helper to the app that launched it, so you see 60 apps instead of 1,000 processes, each with one figure for memory, CPU, energy, disk and network. It keeps 30 days of history, alerts you when an app misbehaves, finds forgotten dev servers, and shows temperatures, fans and battery. Every readout can sit in your menu bar, arranged your way. Pay once. No subscription, no account.

Name: Okara
Tagline: The world's first AI CMO
Description: Okara is an AI CMO. Enter your website and it studies your product, competitors and brand voice, then runs 10+ agents for SEO, AI search, Reddit, X, LinkedIn, creators and UGC video. You approve every draft and it publishes. Used by 100,000+ businesses.

Name: SaleSmartly
Tagline: Turn conversations across every channel into customers
Description: SaleSmartly brings customer conversations from WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, TikTok, Telegram, LINE, WeChat and more into one workspace. Manage leads with a built-in CRM, let AI agents answer questions and qualify customers 24/7, translate conversations in real time, and automate follow-ups—all while your team keeps the context needed to turn more conversations into customers.

Name: Statable Analytics
Tagline: Web analytics built for you and your AI agents
Description: Statable is web analytics built for humans and AI agents. Use the simple dashboard yourself, or connect Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Codex, and other agents through MCP to read reports, analyze traffic, and configure tracking, goals, and funnels. No cookies, no analytics consent banner in most cases, and your data stays hosted in the EU.

Name: GenCode
Tagline: A coding agent inside the Genspark Super App
Description: GenCode is Genspark’s coding agent with Chat and Terminal UIs. It supports models from Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, and more, and works directly on code in a directory you choose.

Name: Microsoft Copilot
Tagline: The Al built for work
Description: The new Copilot connects the tools people rely on with the next generation of capabilities they’ll need to build, customize and scale AI across work. Copilot connects with your work content and the apps you already use, bringing together the latest AI models to help you create finished work, not just answers.

Name: vantage.ai
Tagline: See and control what your coding agent does.
Topics: Software Engineering, Developer Tools, GitHub, Vibe coding
Description: Vantage is a free, open-source cost and usage monitor, guardrail and session log for coding agents.

Name: Ryu Journal
Tagline: A journal to help busy minds let go
Description: Ryu means "flow" in Japanese. That's the whole idea. Ryu Journal is a quiet place to put a thought down and let it go. No accounts, no social feed, no pressure — just you and the page. Open it, write what's on your mind, and get back to your day. WRITE, THEN LET GO A clean, distraction-free editor. Tap the plus, write, save. Tap any entry to keep writing. Your week gathers softly into one simple timeline.

Name: Zerg Router
Tagline: Run DeepSeek in Codex
Description: One OpenAI-compatible endpoint for all your coding agents. The routing policy lives in your account, not inside each tool. • Run DeepSeek 4.1 Flash (or other models) inside Codex, and keep your workflow • Give every API key its own daily budget, enforced per request • Explicit fallbacks: on a 5xx, 429 or timeout, try your next model • See remaining weekly quota and reset dates across Codex accounts Supports paid usage, or bring your own provider keys.

Name: Shotcandy
Tagline: Make Your Screenshots Look Amazing
Topics: Design Tools, Social Media, Marketing, GitHub
Description: Paste a screenshot. Get something lovely. Shotcandy is a free screenshot beautifier that turns plain screenshots into beautiful, share-ready images and videos in seconds, right in your browser.

Name: MuM
Tagline: A reading-first Markdown engine for macOS
Description: Your Markdown lives in a dozen folders. Most of the time you don't want to write — you just want to read one section. Every Markdown tool is a writing app with a preview pane. MuM is the opposite: a native macOS reader with no web engine inside — all AppKit. Several projects open at once, each remembering where you stopped. Cross-project search. Typesetting tuned for CJK as well as Latin. ~0.3s cold start, 1.7 MB download, 100+ fps scrolling a 5 MB document. Open source, MIT.

Name: Lattice
Tagline: Reshape your text across languages while preserving meaning
Description: Lattice reshapes your text through multiple language paths, creating a fresh expression while preserving the original idea.

Name: Harness Router
Tagline: A fast decision layer for smarter AI tool routing.
Topics: Open Source, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence
Description: Harness Router is a decision layer for AI coding agents that improves tool selection before execution. Use it as a Codex hook for automatic routing on every tool call, or as a skill when you want explicit, agent-invoked decisions. It keeps obvious choices fast, uses Jev for ambiguity, and applies MCTS when multi-step consequences matter.

Name: Stash
Tagline: Hidden controls for your Mac.
Description: Stash gives your Mac hidden controls that feel like they’ve always belonged there. Beautiful, native-feeling and ridiculously satisfying to use - adjust system controls with tactile sliders and dials, manage windows, and keep your favourite apps within reach through a hidden expandable dock and app launcher. Stash Deck extends the experience to your iPhone, turning it into a tactile remote for your Mac with quick controls, app launching and configurable widgets.

Name: Dina 4.5
Tagline: Beautiful screen recordings, screenshots, and 3D motion
Description: Record your screen, capture beautiful screenshots, add cinematic 3D motion and perspective, customize every detail, and share instantly with a link. Dina 4.5 brings screen recordings, screenshots, 3D animations, and sharing into one fast, beautifully designed workflow.

Name: Sayble
Tagline: AI copilot for calls that tells you what to say next
Description: Sayble is a real-time AI copilot for sales calls, client meetings and negotiations. It hears what the other person just said and gives you one clear line to say next, plus a backup, in about half a second. When the call ends, it writes the recap and a ready-to-send follow-up email. Works on Zoom, Meet, Teams and phone calls. Mac & Windows, 10 languages.

Name: Arc
Tagline: Your mobile AI assistant on any screen
Topics: Android, Mac, Artificial Intelligence, Menu Bar Apps
Description: Arc is a free AI assistant that works on whatever screen you're already on. You don't have to copy text into a chatbot. Call Arc up over any app and it reads the screen for you. • Summarize articles, chats, emails and docs instantly • Listen: have any screen read aloud • Rewrite replies and messages in the right tone, right where you type • Automate repetitive steps across apps Available on Android and Mac. Free to start.

Name: PIP
Tagline: AI buddy on your computer
Description: Pip is an AI buddy for your Mac. It sees your screen, talks you through it, and points at exactly where to click, even when it takes several clicks.
